samples.question: This picture shows one chain: a single thin dark cord that threads exactly five filled coloured beads, and exactly one bead is drawn clearly larger than the other four. The larger bead is where the walk starts. Walk along the cord from the larger bead, always moving to the next bead the cord reaches, never skipping a bead and never leaving the cord; the beads do not have to be arranged in any particular colour order. Consider the third bead you reach after the larger bead. What colour is that bead? Answer with exactly one of: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
